mapper.insert: INSERT INTO match_record ( source_post_id, target_post_id, keyword_score, vector_score, final_score, notified ) VALUES ( #{sourcePostId}, #{targetPostId}, #{keywordScore}, #{vectorScore}, #{finalScore}, 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE keyword_score = VALUES(keyword_score), vector_score = VALUES(vector_score), final_score = VALUES(final_score), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
